text.zh: 生成当前项目的敏捷运营报告，覆盖迭代健康、需求分布、缺陷热点和测试质量
text.en: Generate an agile operations report for the current project covering sprint health, requirement distribution, defect hotspots and test quality

text.zh: 为当前项目生成一份可打印的质量通报公文，包含缺陷趋势、测试覆盖和发布就绪度结论
text.en: Generate a printable quality bulletin for the current project with defect trends, test coverage and a release-readiness conclusion

text.zh: 用周报模板输出本迭代的进展简报
text.en: Output this sprint’s progress brief using the weekly report template

text.zh: 分析当前迭代的燃尽情况，判断能否按时收尾，说明依据和风险
text.en: Analyze the current sprint’s burndown, judge whether it can land on time, and explain the evidence and risks

text.zh: 对比所有项目的交付健康度，给出排名和掉队项目的原因
text.en: Compare delivery health across all projects, rank them, and explain why the lagging ones fall behind

text.zh: 读取我当前正在看的这个页面的内容，总结出关键信息和异常项
text.en: Read the page I am currently looking at and summarize the key information and anomalies

text.zh: 在新窗口打开当前项目的交付监控大屏：迭代进度、缺陷分布、测试质量与 DORA 指标一屏总览
text.en: Open the current project’s delivery monitoring screen in a new window: sprint progress, defect distribution, test quality and DORA metrics on one page

text.zh: 对当前迭代做收尾核对，覆盖假完成需求、未关闭缺陷分级和测试覆盖缺口，给出结转清单与下迭代建议
text.en: Run the end-of-sprint closeout for the current project: audit false-Done requirements, triage open defects by severity, check coverage gaps, and produce carry-over items with next-sprint recommendations

text.zh: 把所有项目的交付质量做成一份幻灯片，在新窗口里放映，支持翻页和导出 PDF
text.en: Turn delivery quality across all projects into a slide deck, present it in a new window with page navigation and PDF export
